mechanism: Physiological depletion and social pressure accumulate into a generalized stress burden.
measurement: Derived from hunger deficit, fatigue, illness burden, and morale loss.
interaction_rules: stress_load rises with unmet needs and low support
illness multiplies the effect of fatigue on stress
pathological_extremes: collapse into passive idling or crisis actions
real_world_validation: chronic stress impairs cognition and worsens health outcomes
implementation_notes: recomputed every tick from compact state

mechanism: Low liquidity plus biological need pressure increase the chance of unmet essentials.
measurement: Derived from available cash and hunger pressure relative to local food cost.
interaction_rules: deprivation rises as cash falls below subsistence reserves
inflation increases deprivation even at stable wages
job income reduces deprivation with a delay
real_world_validation: economic precarity predicts stress, illness, and reduced agency
implementation_notes: uses agent money and world food cost

mechanism: Positive bonds and repeated reciprocal interactions form a stabilizing support network.
state_space: Continuous scalar from 0 to 100 plus directional edge list.
measurement: Aggregated from friend count, rival count, and relationship bond strengths.
interaction_rules: friend bonds increase support faster than acquaintances
rival bonds subtract from perceived safety
marriage adds a persistent support floor
real_world_validation: social support protects against distress and poor health
implementation_notes: updated after social actions and life events

mechanism: An active illness consumes energy, increases frailty, and compounds unmet needs.
measurement: Stored as illness severity when sick, zero otherwise.
interaction_rules: illness severity increases each tick while untreated
doctor visits can reset illness burden
real_world_validation: disease severity interacts with nutrition and exhaustion

mechanism: Energy, morale, and illness jointly influence how coherently an agent can select actions.
measurement: Derived from energy, happiness, and illness burden.
interaction_rules: clarity decreases with illness and exhaustion
higher clarity improves work and social decisions
real_world_validation: cognitive performance declines with sleep loss and illness
implementation_notes: derived feature used by decision scoring

mechanism: Age progression changes eligibility for work, marriage, fertility, and frailty.
measurement: Derived from age ticks converted to simulation years.
interaction_rules: fertility depends on adult stage and sex-specific constraints
real_world_validation: age strongly shapes work capacity, fertility, and mortality
implementation_notes: persisted as age ticks, exposed as derived life stage

mechanism: An agent's current job and adult status determine how legible their function is to the wider settlement.
measurement: Derived from employment status, adulthood, and specialized role occupancy.
interaction_rules: named jobs increase role legibility more than unemployment
specialized jobs add a prestige premium
real_world_validation: clear social roles improve coordination and trust in communities
implementation_notes: derived from job and life stage

mechanism: Ambient weather modifies comfort, mood, and stamina over time.
state_space: Categorical weather mapped to continuous impact weights.
measurement: Computed from current world weather and environmental effect table.
interaction_rules: stormy weather applies stronger negative modifiers than cloudy weather
sunny conditions add mild energy and morale recovery
pathological_extremes: morale collapse under repeated harsh weather
real_world_validation: weather and light exposure affect mood and energy

mechanism: Skill accumulation, energy, and role access determine how effectively an agent can use work tools and routines.
measurement: Derived from job skill, energy, and ambition.
interaction_rules: every work action slightly increases job-specific skill
capability increases wages up to a multiplier ceiling
real_world_validation: human capital and experience increase productivity and earning power
implementation_notes: stored as skill per job and exposed as derived capability

mechanism: Sociability, low morale, and unmet support needs create pressure to initiate communication.
measurement: Derived from sociability trait, morale deficit, and social support level.
interaction_rules: low support increases outreach more strongly for social personalities
reclusive personalities dampen outreach despite low happiness
successful social contact can reduce future outreach pressure
real_world_validation: personality and loneliness affect social-seeking behavior
implementation_notes: derived feature used in dimensional state and social planning

mechanism: Multiple pressures stack into a single causal burden that predicts breakdown or recovery difficulty.
measurement: Derived from deprivation risk, illness burden, and weak social support.
interaction_rules: stacked moderate pressures can be more dangerous than one isolated extreme
support and resilience reduce crisis amplification
persistent crisis load degrades morale over time
real_world_validation: compounding social, economic, and health stressors produce nonlinear breakdown risk

mechanism: Traits, support, and current morale create recovery capacity under pressure.
measurement: Derived from empathy, ambition, happiness, and illness burden.
interaction_rules: social support boosts resilience more when morale is low
pathological_extremes: inability to recover from small setbacks
real_world_validation: resilience is shaped by internal traits and external social buffers
implementation_notes: derived feature available on every agent snapshot

mechanism: Currency and demand deposits held by agents, subject to inflation erosion.

interaction_rules: inflation reduces real value over time
